qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Single-asset holding company holding ~36.3% of biopharma firm UCB SA. UCB faces constant patent cliffs, statutory government drug price regulation (European health authorities and US IRA), and multi-cycle GAAP ROIC below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Monoline holding company whose sole asset is a ~36.3% controlling stake in biopharma firm UCB SA. Pharmaceutical drug developers lack autonomous pricing power >= inflation due to statutory health authority price caps and US PBM rebate pressures, while patent expirations require continuous high R&D reinvestment, resulting in sub-hurdle multi-cycle ROIC.
qualitative.evidence: Financière de Tubize's reported ROIC is ~5.1% median, and look-through operating asset UCB SA earns multi-year GAAP ROIC below the 12% hurdle (historical average 7-8% GAAP ROIC). Drug pricing is subject to mandatory state concessions and patent cliff generic erosion.
